name: Astrid Olsen
bio:
Astrid's motorsport journey began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the icy fjords of Norway, where she honed her mechanical skills modifying snowmobiles for extreme endurance races. This practical, hands-on experience, coupled with a late-in-life engineering degree, gave her a unique perspective on vehicle dynamics and performance under pressure. Her career in racing started in rallycross before transitioning to circuit racing. 

As a race engineer, Astrid is known for her meticulous data analysis and innovative problem-solving, often finding unconventional solutions to complex issues. Her ambition drives her to constantly seek improvement, pushing both the car and the team to their limits. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their expertise.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Astrid is a woman of medium build with a perpetually focused expression and a scattering of freckles across her nose.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn multi-tool.
Insists on having a specific brand of Norwegian coffee on race days.
Frequently uses analogies involving boats and the sea to explain technical concepts.
